en: Back of a vintage divided-back postcard with the British royal coat of arms and the heading POST CARD. Printed British usage instructions appear on the left, a vertical publisher credit for Raphael Tuck & Sons is present, and the address is handwritten to Miss Christine Anderson, to Mrs Raymond, Strawberry Hill, Stamford. A green U.S. 1¢ Franklin stamp is affixed at the top right.
